Memora explores agent memory as a lifecycle: ingestion, structured memory representation, deduplication/consolidation, cue indexing, semantic/prompted/hybrid retrieval, and experimental RL-based retrieval. Its representation separates full memory values from indexed abstractions and cue anchors.

NosAi relevance:
- episodic/semantic/procedural memory separation;
- provenance-aware consolidation;
- hybrid retrieval and cue indexing;
- retrieval-policy experiments in simulation only.

This local file is a research synopsis rather than a verbatim copy of the upstream README. See the upstream repository and recorded SHA for the full source.
